title: LAUSGROUP SUBSIDIARY CORPORATE GUARANTEE LEVERAGES INSURANCE INNOVATION TO PROTECT 300 LEARNERS UNDER PBSP READY FOR SCHOOL 2026
description:
PAMPANGA, Philippines – Corporate Guarantee (CG), LausGroup of Companies’ non-life insurance subsidiary, took part in the Philippine Business for Social Progress (PBSP) Ready for School 2026 (RFS 2026) program, in support of the Department of Education’s initiative to strengthen school readiness by ensuring public schools are better equipped to support both teachers and learners ahead of the new academic year. 

“School readiness goes beyond preparing classrooms, it is about ensuring that students are protected and supported so learning can continue with fewer disruptions and greater peace of mind for families. Through our continued partnership with the Philippine Business for Social Progress, we aim to contribute in a more meaningful way by helping create learning environments that are not only prepared, but also safer and more resilient for every child,” said Ms. Ched Limson, Chief Operating Officer of Corporate Guarantee. 

As schools and communities prepare for a new academic year, school readiness often focuses on classroom repairs, learning materials, and facility improvements. Corporate Guarantee sought to contribute from a different perspective, helping ensure that students are protected from unforeseen incidents that may affect their well-being and ability to continue learning. 

Instead of providing a traditional cash donation, Corporate Guarantee leveraged its expertise as an insurer to provide a customized personal accident insurance package for 300 selected learners from Grades 1 to 3 at Highway Hills Integrated School in Mandaluyong. The initiative demonstrates how insurance can serve as a practical tool for community support, extending protection to students and providing added peace of mind to their families. 

The arrangement also generated an estimated PHP 35,000 in sponsorship cost savings for PBSP, allowing resources to be maximized while expanding the program's impact. Under the coverage, each student received accidental death and dismemberment benefits of PHP 50,000, medical reimbursement of PHP 2,000, animal bite coverage of PHP 2,000, and burial assistance of PHP 2,000, with an annual premium of PHP 100 per student, inclusive of taxes. 

Now in its third consecutive year of participation, CG’s involvement in PBSP’s flagship back-to-school initiative reflects its sustained commitment to supporting public school communities, following earlier engagements at Placido del Mundo Elementary School in 2024 and Balara Elementary School in 2025. 

The initiative was supported by 15 employee volunteers from Corporate Information Systems and Solutions Division (CISSD), Corporate Marketing Services (CMS), Human Resource Management Division (HRMD), and Car Carrier teams. Beyond supporting on-site activities, the volunteer effort provided employees with an opportunity to contribute to a shared cause, strengthening camaraderie and reinforcing the company's culture of service. 

During the official handover ceremony, Corporate Guarantee and PBSP formally presented the Certificate of Insurance Coverage to Highway Hills Integrated School, symbolizing the protection extended to 300 learners under the program. The school, in turn, awarded Corporate Guarantee a Certificate of Appreciation in recognition of its continued support for education and community development, reflecting the shared commitment of the private sector, civil society, and schools in helping students start the academic year prepared and protected. 

“By combining education support with protection initiatives, we hope to contribute not only to learning continuity but also to the overall well-being and security of students and their families. We are honored to continue supporting PBSP’s Ready for School program and look forward to creating a lasting impact in more communities in the years ahead,” added Ms. Ched Limson.

title: CORPORATE GUARANTEE JOINS FIRE PREVENTION MONTH KICK OFF
description:
CITY OF SAN FERNANDO (P) – On March 1, 2026, Corporate Guarantee was at the Benigno S. Aquino Hall in Capitol Compound, Brgy. Sto. Nino here. Done yearly, Corporate Guarantee marks this day as the start of their month-long propagation of this national awareness campaign – Fire Prevention Month – being part of their long-time advocacy and embedded in their organizational culture. 

Converging at the venue together with other commercial institutions and advocate groups were the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) headed by FSSupt. Jose Raymund Manimbo, the Provincial Fire Marshall – the main proponents of this campaign. It was an early morning assembly as early as 5a.m. The throng of people representing the various sectors arrived one at a time and began adorning their respective vehicles with streamers and balloons as they prepare for the motorcade within the City of San Fernando. The motorcade traversed major thoroughfares blowing sirens and horns to effectively make citizens aware of the start of this highly important campaign. 

Generally, citizens are aware of the kind of devastation that fire and conflagration can bring to our society, and spreading awareness to prevent such mishap is very important. In 2023 and 2024 alone, the cost of damages to residential and commercial property due to fire reaches an approximate P13 to P14 Billion pesos. While the origin of incidence varies, the economic impact remains consistently high, often driven by electrical faults and unattended open flames mostly in rural residential areas. There are over 18, 000 reported incidents in the latter year. The motorcade ended once they reached the original starting point, where a modest breakfast meal was shared among all participants. 

Representing Corporate Guarantee in this meaningful activity was Ms. Kathleen Eusebio and Mr. Jonathan Lledo.

title: Corporate Guarantee tenders heartfelt love this Yuletide Season
description:
It is often popularly said that when you count your blessings you don’t pay it back, you pay it forward. Corporate Guarantee brought exactly that as they demonstrated their brand of love, warmth and hospitality to two critical institutions, whose patrons might as well have been forgotten, marginalized, maligned, neglected, sexually abused and exploited youth. 

Devoid of social interaction and inclusion, and cared for only by trained social technicians, these children live only in existential trauma and horror from their involuntary experiences, which produced shattered dreams, loss of belief and self-confidence and even betrayal. 

On the afternoon of December 12, 2025, hope, love, life and laughter sprung anew for these unfortunate children as Corporate Guarantee executives together with LausGroup HRMD paid a visit to Preda Homes for Abused Women in Subic, Zambales where a 7-month-old baby along with 63 children ages 1 - 21 were kept for psychological and therapeutic healing. Once more, they felt the warmth and love of a caring society as Corporate Guarantee spent an afternoon to interact, have fun and enjoy a hearty and generous meal for everyone. 

Of course, the occasion would not be complete without the giving of gifts which not only transcends CG’s care and love, but also upholds the spirit of the season. The day ended with stuffed stomachs, pockets and heartfelt smiles that no amount of money can buy. 

3 days later, On December 15, 2025 Corporate Guarantee left their vivid imprint in the hearts and minds of women and children belonging to the AMOR Village – a home for mistreated, disadvantaged, abandoned or abused children who are in the care of DSWD Social Welfare Officers in Moncada, Anao, Tarlac. 

They proceeded to bring joy and warmth to the AMOR Village residents as much as what they had brought to Preda Homes residents. As expected, they elicited the same if not more – amount of love, happiness and joy from the grateful crowd. 

Truly, love unshaken rebuilds hope and inspires a brighter future even for the less fortunate. Corporate Guarantee represented by some of its key officers namely: Ms. Clariz Naguit – Admin Head, Ms. Apple Grace Barrientos – Service Support Manager, Ms. Glamour De Leon – Finance Asst. Supervisor, Ms. Kathleen Eusebio – Marketing & Junior Secretary and Mr. Hernan Salisi – Underwriting, has definitely brought that even in this small and precarious part of the world, where hope flickers amid the darkness.

Mr. Levy Adrian Laus meanwhile stated how CG prides itself into being a consistent ISO : 9001-2015 certified company – a manifesto to its outstanding and world-class management system with the DNA of a purely homegrown enterprise started by the late patriarch, Levy P. Laus.

 Corporate Guarantee remains anchored to its motto of enduring commitment. It sets its eyes to a bigger and more vibrant celebration for its 30th anniversary next year.

title: CORPORATE GUARANTEE ONE OF THE SPONSORS IN CARWORLD’S PICKLEBALL TOURNEY
description:
City of San Fernando - Corporate Guarantee (CG) takes part in the competitive yet festive atmosphere of Carworld’s 48th anniversary Pickleball Tournament held in Vista Mall here in the city. 

A successful event with more than 200 participants, CG was in the middle of it all as it also gave out Insurance Gift Vouchers to the top finishers in every category. Present representing CG was none other than Director and Marketing Head of Corporate Guarantee, Levy Adrian Laus. 

Laus together with Carworld’s top executives Mr. Donald Calma and Mr. Alfie Adriano spearheaded the awarding of medals, cash prizes, and certificates. The ceremonies was also graced by CG Executive Director, Ms. Carisa Laus. 

It was an eventful day that started at 8:30 in the morning and lasted until 4:00 p.m. for the tournament itself, while two Open Play sessions followed in the afternoon until 10:30 in the evening. The energy was palpable throughout the event as one of the fast-growing sports enjoyed today by many Filipinos, finds a way to break the stereotype weekend routine and active sports life hobby.

title: CORPORATE GUARANTEE FOSTERS DEEP REGARD IN VALUING ITS COMMITMENT
description:
Clark Freeport Zone - Once again, Corporate Guarantee (CG) stands firm and true, upholding its promise to its stakeholders - “We Value Our Commitment.”  On July 31, 2026, CG went to visit a newly insured firm in the Freeport Zone of Clark in Angeles City. 

In the modern and fast paced, changing times, the people, management and catalysts of growth - specially in thriving industries like manufacturing - greatly understand the value and importance of having insurance protection. Uncertainties and proneness to mishaps in daily operations, destructive natural calamities, or simply unforeseen accidents specially in the workplace are considered potential deterrence to what is otherwise an escalating and steady growth to industrial progress. 

CG - with its key officers - obligingly visited the facility of its newly insured customer and inspected its manufacturing base. With Deputy COO, Giovanni Miranda and Sales Head for CG HO, Rushel Torres, CG assures robust and dependable insurance service to its newly established client. Also in behalf of CG, they wish to extend their thanks for the invaluable trust and confidence in Corporate Guarantee.

title: CORPORATE GUARANTEE IS AT INDUCTION OF OFFICERS FOR PAMPANGA FEDERATION OF RURAL BANKS
description:
City of San Fernando (P))—On August 6, 2026, the General Meeting of the Pampanga Federation of Rural Banks took place at the Eastgate Convention Center here. It also heralded the induction of new officers of the said federation. 

The Pampanga Federation of Rural Banks Inc. (PFRB) is a local association of rural financial institutions housed locally in the province of Pampanga. It is a unified group representing rural banks—such as Guagua Rural Bank and Bank of Florida (BOF)—in support of countryside economic growth, boosting financial inclusion through a collaboration with government agencies on programs that boost depositor confidence, financial literacy, and local economic stability, and the coordination with national groups like the Rural Bankers Association of the Philippines (RBAP). 

The federation also assists small agricultural producers, local entrepreneurs, and marginalized sectors by strengthening rural credit access. 

Corporate Guarantee witnessed the event unfold as one of the sponsors to this important event. There to represent Corporate Guarantee were Ms. Rushel Torres, Ms. Kenesse Teodoro and Ms. Mildred Ortilla.
